map.保护届满 = 起算日 + 法定保护年限（自然人著作:死亡后50年;法人著作:发表: Protection expiry = start date + statutory term (natural-person copyright: 50 years after death; legal-person copyright: 50 years after publication; invention 20 years; utility model 10 years; design 15 years; trademark 10 years)
map.著作权（自然人）保护至作者死亡后第50年的12月31日；著作权（法人或职务作品）: Copyright of a natural person runs to 31 December of the 50th year after the author's death; copyright of a legal person or a work made for hire runs to 31 December of the 50th year after first publication. Inventions run 20 years, utility models 10 years and designs 15 years, all from the filing date. Trademark exclusivity runs 10 years from the date registration is approved and may be renewed. Enter the start year or date to obtain the expiry date.
map.著作权·自然人作品（终生+死后50年）: Copyright · natural person (life + 50 years after death)
map.著作权·法人/视听作品（发表后50年）: Copyright · legal person / audiovisual work (50 years after publication)

map.外观设计专利自 2021 年 6 月 1 日起申请的适用 15 年，此前申请适用: Design patents filed on or after 2021-06-01 enjoy 15 years; those filed earlier enjoy 10 years.
map.注册商标有效期 10 年自核准注册日起算，期满可续展，每次续展 10 年。: A registered trademark is valid for 10 years from the date registration is approved and may be renewed for successive 10-year periods.
map.申请日 2020-05-10，发明专利权期限 20 年自申请日起算，到期日 =: Filing date 2020-05-10: an invention patent runs 20 years from filing, expiring on 2040-05-10; the remaining term decreases year by year.
map.核准注册日 2020-01-01，有效期 10 年，到期日 = 2030-01-: Registration approved 2020-01-01, valid 10 years, expiring 2030-01-01; renewal may be filed within the 12 months before expiry and extends the term another 10 years to 2040-01-01.

map.自然人作品保护期为作者终生及其死亡后 50 年；法人或非法人组织作品、视听作品保: A natural person's work is protected for the author's life plus 50 years after death; works of a legal person or unincorporated organization and audiovisual works are protected for 50 years after first publication, to 31 December of the 50th year.
map.专利年费不交会怎样？: What happens if patent annuities go unpaid?
map.未按规定缴纳年费的，专利权自应当缴纳年费期满之日起终止；终止后技术进入公有领域，: If annuities are not paid as required, the patent lapses from the date the annuity period expires; the technology then enters the public domain and anyone may exploit it.
